Tickets in pictures

Around the city. These photos set the scene; they are not of the places listed on this page.

KaribuFans does not sell or resell tickets, and never takes payment.
Buy only from the seller the club, league or event organiser names. No official ticket page is linked here yet; we add one only once its organiser announces it.

Matches and events in Nairobi

Status labels: On sale · Opens soon · Sold out · Official resale (only if the organisers run one).

Nairobi fixtures will appear here once they are officially published. Each match will show its sale status and a link to the official ticket site.

Get told when sales open

This opens WhatsApp with your request written out; you press send. Nothing is stored on this site.

Avoid fake tickets

  • Buy only from the official sellerIgnore sellers on social media and WhatsApp groups.
  • Never pay a person by M-Pesa for a ticketOfficial sales do not ask you to send money to a personal number.
  • Check the ticket rulesID and name-on-ticket rules are set by each organiser. Read them before you buy.
